inlines.v: VI'TALLY, adverb 1. In such a manner as to give life. The organic structure of human bodies, by which they are fitted to live and move, and to be vitally informed by the soul, is the workmanship of a most wise and beneficent maker. 2. Essentially; as vitally important.
